quote: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal: The driver of a vehicle shall stop in obedience to a stop sign or yield in compliance with a yield sign, in compliance with the manner prescribed in subsection 1 [NRS-484B-257-1], prior to entering an intersection if a stop sign or a yield sign is erected at one or more entrances thereto although not a part of a through highway and shall proceed cautiously, yielding to vehicles not so obligated to stop or yield and which are within the intersection or approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection.

activation.source_clause: if a stop sign or a yield sign is erected at one or more entrances thereto although not a part of a through highway
activation.description: Subject entrance is governed by a stop or yield sign at a non-through intersection; all entrance controls must be observed.

obligation.source_clause: shall stop in obedience to a stop sign or yield in compliance with a yield sign, in compliance with the manner prescribed in subsection 1 [NRS-484B-257-1], prior to entering an intersection
obligation.description: Sign-specific pre-entry action and incorporated stopping-reference hierarchy.

obligation.source_clause: shall proceed cautiously, yielding to vehicles not so obligated to stop or yield and which are within the intersection or approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection
obligation.description: Post-entry caution and continued yielding to a not-obligated counterpart inside or approaching; legal judgments unresolved.

exceptions.source_clause: traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal
exceptions.description: Original officer direction or governing signal control is an exception.

timing.source_clause: during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection
timing.description: Assess counterpart phase throughout the crossing/within interval.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original motion, conflict and visibility measurements do not define a legal cautiousness cutoff.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard
judgment_calls_needed.note: Keep measured approach distance and time to conflict separate from legal hazard judgment.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: yielding to vehicles not so obligated to stop or yield
judgment_calls_needed.note: Whole-intersection sign inventory and original counterpart occupancy are needed; right-of-way conclusion is independent.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original per-frame officer direction or governing signal state requires independent review.
